en:
Battle of Gifu Castle
Victory Conditions
  1. Make Tokugawa Ieyasu retreat
Defeat Conditions
  1. Mouri Terumoto retreats
  2. Mouri HQ is captured
  3. More than 99 turns pass

Battle of Gifu Castle

Victory Conditions
  1. Make Tokugawa Ieyasu retreat
Defeat Conditions
  1. Mouri Terumoto retreats
  2. Mouri HQ is captured
  3. More than 99 turns pass
note: 0.2.14: names written in full; the boxes now take 240 px (narration window) / 256 px (goal box) per line.
Same form as 'Mikawa Coast' (U02176).

en:
Beaten by the Mouri at Gifu,
Ieyasu fled the castle with a few
soldiers, making for Mikawa.



But on the retreat, they ran into
peasants hunting fleeing warriors.
His men fell away, first one,
then another...
until at last only Ieyasu
was left.
Ieyasu, too, was badly wounded.
Barely clinging to life,
he somehow managed to reach
the coast of Owari.

note: Flashback: young Takechiyo (Ieyasu) with his parents.
JP blank lines are deliberate pauses; kept as page breaks.

en:
Victors over the Tokugawa
at Gifu, Terumoto and the
Mouri returned to Kyoto...

After that, what became
of the Mouri, who had
marched on Kyoto;
what became of the army
that marched on Bungo;

and what became of
Terumoto and Hotaru...
is another story...

$&
Mouri Motonari:
Oath of the Three Arrows
